name: vwap_mean_reversion_v14
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the index reaches a 2.2-sigma deviation below session VWAP while 1-minute EMA-smoothed volume is 1.8x the 20-minute volume baseline, multiple VWAP-benchmarked institutional programs have triggered simultaneously — not a single-algo spike but a convergent forced-sell cascade sustained across at least 60 seconds. The EMA-smoothed volume ratio (vs single raw bar in other variants) confirms the selling is a persistent wave, not a data artifact. The entry fires only on the first bar where the z-score begins improving (zscore_delta > 0), marking the precise inflection where passive market-makers with resting buy orders sitting 0.3-0.5% below VWAP have absorbed the cascade's tail. At this moment on NIFTY, the sell-side order queue is depleted and the next 30-90 seconds produce a 12-20 spot point snap-back as the book replenishes from the bid side.
core_signal_oneliner: EMA-smoothed volume surge (1.8x, 60s sustained) at -2.2 sigma VWAP deviation, entry only on first bar of z-score improvement (inflection)
